judge.voice: ok, i would use it again. it was about kpop so i did not feel stupid, and i understood every task. i was surprised it said B1, i thought A2 maybe. the fix was good, i see my mistake "i think is real music" and now i know the "it". but the line "pointed elsewhere" was weird, like it did not trust itself. also my sentence with the mistake is on the big TV and my brother can see it, that is not nice. i like that i could type. it was quick, nobody heard me. i would tell my friend from the server, maybe. i want it to help me answer in the chat for real.
